description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to message output and publishing within the WPEFramework project. It includes abstract interfaces for publishing messages, concrete implementations for console, syslog, file, JSON formatted output, UDP, and WebSocket outputs, as well as data structures for JSON message formatting and configuration commands.

classes.name: IPublish
classes.description: Interface for message publishing with a virtual Message method.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Class responsible for converting message info and text into a formatted string.

classes.name: ConsoleOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs messages to the console.

classes.name: SyslogOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs messages to syslog.

classes.name: FileOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that writes messages to a file.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: Class for formatting and outputting messages in JSON format, with configurable options.

classes.name: JSON::Data
classes.description: Data container class for JSON message formatting.

classes.name: UDPOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that sends messages over UDP.

classes.name: WebSocketOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that manages WebSocket connections for message output, including configuration commands.

classes.name: WebSocketOutput::ExportCommand
classes.description: JSON container for WebSocket export configuration commands.

classes.name: WebSocketOutput::Channel
classes.description: Represents a UDP socket channel used by WebSocketOutput for data transmission.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Virtual method in IPublish interface for publishing a message.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Method in Text class to convert message info and text into a formatted string.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Method in ConsoleOutput, SyslogOutput, FileOutput, and other classes to output messages.

methods.name: FileName
methods.description: Getter and setter for JSON output option to include filename.

methods.name: LineNumber
methods.description: Getter and setter for JSON output option to include line number.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Getter and setter for JSON output option to include class name.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Getter and setter for JSON output option to include category.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Getter and setter for JSON output option to include callsign.

methods.name: Date
methods.description: Getter and setter for JSON output option to include date.

methods.name: Paused
methods.description: Getter and setter for JSON output option to include paused state.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Method to convert message metadata and text into JSON data structure.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Method in Channel class to send data over UDP socket.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Method in UDPOutput and WebSocketOutput classes to send messages.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Method in WebSocketOutput to initialize WebSocket server with a service and max connections.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Method in WebSocketOutput to clean up resources.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Method to attach a new WebSocket client connection.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Method to detach a WebSocket client connection.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Method to process configuration commands received over WebSocket.

methods.name: Command
methods.description: Method to get a new configuration command object.
